job.title: AI Engineer
job.description:
This client is not buying off-the-shelf solutions. They're custom-building everything - from infrastructure to intelligent agents - to create a best-in-class AI platform that redefines what's possible in enterprise automation.

We're currently looking for a high-impact AI Engineer to join their Sydney-based team and help design and develop agentic AI systems that can reason, plan, and act autonomously across complex business domains.

What You'll Be Doing: 
  • Designing and implementing agentic AI systems capable of autonomous decision-making and task execution.
  • Building custom LLM pipelines, memory architectures, and tool-use frameworks.
  • Collaborating with product and engineering teams to integrate AI into real-world workflows.
  • Contributing to the development of our proprietary AI platform - no plug-and-play, all innovation.
What We're Looking For: 
  • Proven experience in building AI/ML systems, ideally with Azure OpenAI, Azure Cognitive Services Azure Machine Learning.
  • Strong Python skills and familiarity with modern AI frameworks (e.g., LangChain, Hugging Face, PyTorch).
  • Deep understanding of LLMs, vector databases, prompt engineering, and multi-agent systems.
  • Passion for building from scratch - you thrive in greenfield environments.
Why Join?
  • Be part of a visionary team building something truly unique.
  • Work on cutting-edge AI challenges with full ownership and creative freedom.
  • Competitive salary, equity options, and a culture of innovation.
  • Strong Python skills and familiarity with modern AI frameworks (e.g., LangChain, Hugging Face, PyTorch).
  • Deep understanding of LLMs, vector databases, prompt engineering, and multi-agent systems.
  • Passion for building from scratch - you thrive in greenfield environments.
For more information and a confidential chat, please email - karl@mayvunarc.com

job.title: Data Engineer
job.description:
Mayvun Arc Recruitment have partnered with a global consulting organisation who are growing rapidly across Sydney, Melbourne & Brisbane. We are seeking Data Engineers at all levels who can work in a dynamic, fast-moving team of technologists and other data enthusiasts who live for solving big challenges. This client helps businesses unlock the power of their data, working across cutting-edge platforms like Databricks, Snowflake, GCP, AWS, and Azure.

Key Responsibilities:
  • Work closely with businesses across different sectors to understand their challenges and provide tailored, strategic data solutions.
  • Design and implement advanced data models and architecture, optimizing for scalability and performance.
  • Use your deep expertise in one or more platforms like Databricks, Snowflake, GCP, AWS, or Azure, and your broad knowledge of others, to solve complex technical challenges.
  • You’ll be the go-to person for communicating solutions and guiding clients to data-driven decisions, making sure they understand how they are adding value.
Background:
  • Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Mathematics, Physics, Computer Science, Data Science, Information Technology, or related fields.
  • Hands-on expertise with at least one of these platforms: Databricks, Snowflake, GCP, AWS, or Azure - plus a broad understanding across others.
  • Experience designing and implementing scalable data models.
  • You love working with clients, solving problems, and explaining complex tech ideas in a way that makes sense to everyone.
  • You’re not afraid to ask the big questions, push boundaries, and dive into new tech.
  • Work fast, work smart, and support the team every step of the way.
Why Join:
  • They are small enough to move fast and adapt quickly, but big enough to work with some seriously cool clients across multiple industries.
  • They are passionate about helping you become the senior leader you’re destined to be, whether you’re mentoring junior staff or taking on a big project solo, your growth is their priority.
  • You’ll be part of a team that loves new ideas, thrives on collaboration, and isn’t afraid to take risks to get the best results for clients.
  • No two days are the same, and you’ll love the diversity of the projects and industries you’ll get to work with.

job.title: AI/ML Engineer
job.description:
Mayvun Arc has partnered with a venture-funded technology company using AI to transform a large, traditional industry. They’ve already raised significant funding, work with major enterprise customers, and are scaling a high-performing engineering team to build AI systems that power complex, real-world workflows.

The Role:
 
You’ll join as an AI/ML Engineer, building and deploying AI systems that improve speed, accuracy, and customer experience across mission-critical operations. This is a hands-on role for someone who wants to ship quickly, work closely with domain experts, and turn complex processes into production-ready AI workflows.

What You’ll Do: 
  • Build AI systems that improve accuracy, speed, and decision-making
  • Turn complex operational processes into AI-driven workflows
  • Deploy ML solutions into production at scale
  • Work closely with domain experts, users, and founders
  • Help shape the engineering culture as the team grows
Requirements:
  • 2+ years’ experience in AI/ML engineering or research
  • A track record of delivering AI/ML projects from concept to production
  • Strong product instincts and a bias for shipping
  • The ability to work well with non-technical users
  • Comfort operating in a fast-paced, ambiguous startup environment
  • Excitement for an intense, high-performance culture
For more information and a confidential chat, please email - karl@mayvunarc.com
